decisions.reason: The source assigns roles to the main and sensor boards and does not change the power board's mechanical form factor.
The main- and sensor-board role descriptions do not alter the power board's four-layer stack.
The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE recording its role as a connector hub for sensors, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
Describing the main board as a standard ESP32-S3 board does not necessarily change the established interboard power connector or matching-pin-order rule.
The source does not change the established charge-status indication through the main board's SK6812 LED chain.
The source concerns the roles of the other two boards and does not modify the power-board battery connector interface.
The broad main-board role description does not entail any change to I2C speed, pull-ups, resistor policy, or cable constraints.
The source does not alter component availability, sourcing, or compatible-alternative requirements.
The main- and sensor-board role descriptions do not specify any change to the existing interboard signal connector or pinout.
Making the sensor board a connector hub does not change the separate requirement for intermittently switched 5V sensor power.
The source does not discuss or alter power-board battery protection or thermal sensing.
The architectural role descriptions do not change the deferred power-board BOM part-number obligation.
